purpose: Small development-only source-relative extraction task following scorer hardening.
parsePolicy: Return one canonical candidate for answerable rows; explicitly abstain when the source is outside the task profile or semantically unresolved.
kindPolicy: Every parse row is an event-level declarative proposition; use kind=event. This is a task-level extraction profile, not a general language rule.

termTypePolicy.agent: actor or system according to the named source participant; named people are actor and named services are system
termTypePolicy.object: document for report/file/upload identifiers when used as transmitted artifacts
termTypePolicy.theme: access for an access target; document for a report; task for an upload operation
termTypePolicy.time: date for an ISO calendar date

identityPolicy: Exact identity is comparable only for source-visible stable names, identifiers, literal quantities, dates, and explicitly task-typed roles. No private handle may be inferred.
polarityPolicy: negated=false for lexical allow/prohibit; negated=true means NOT that lexical predicate. Do not infer NOT PROHIBIT from ALLOW or vice versa.
criticalContrastPolicy: The extractor is not told which rows form contrasts; contrast definitions remain scorer-private.
independence: Targets are reviewed after authoring; extraction must be performed by a fresh agent that did not author or review targets. Prompt-level isolation only unless a stronger sandbox is recorded.
